purpose: Before side of the hosting-migration value scorecard. Claims such as ship faster, catch breaks faster, and roll back instantly are measured after cutover against these numbers — not asserted in advance.

claims_to_measure_after_cutover.claim: merge-to-live wall-clock is shorter under Pages-primary than under GitHub Pages + mirror
detection latency for visitor-visible outages is shorter with post-flip gates than manual discovery
operator restore wall-clock after a bad flip is shorter than multi-layer manual recovery

merge_to_live.method: GitHub Actions run_started_at to updated_at on successful main-branch runs of Deploy site (build + deploy + live-URL smoke).

merge_to_live.note: Wall-clock is workflow end-to-end, not cold CDN propagation. Fastly/GH redirect-cache lag (~10 min class) is a separate residual after a bad DNS/CNAME change and is not included in these deploy times.

detection_latency_exemplars.summary: cityscroll.org served ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS while Deploy site reported success. Detection was a human browser visit, not an automated gate (live-URL smoke landed afterward as PR #156).
detection_latency_exemplars.related_bound_note: Documented platform redirect-cache lag class after CNAME/DNS mistakes (tools/live_url_smoke.mjs retry window ~12 min).
detection_latency_exemplars.gate_that_would_catch_now: default live_url_smoke + HUMAN-PATH JOURNEY on post-flip

detection_latency_exemplars.summary: Daily digest cron at 13:00 UTC left sent_today=0 with no durable last_run receipt (silent-five-day-alert / dual-write class). First observer reads of /stats at 13:06Z and 13:10Z.
detection_latency_exemplars.gate_that_would_catch_now: EMAIL HEALTH + STATS SANITY named post-flip checks

detection_latency_exemplars.summary: Worker/API CORS or route failure class: static HTML can still 200 while browser features die (subscribe, events, stats panels).
detection_latency_exemplars.detection_channel: feature failure / console; not covered by HTML-only smoke

rollback_estimate.source: Operator static-hosting cutover runbook rollback sequence (Pages custom domains off, Worker apex/www routes restored, re-smoke)
steps: Remove cityscroll.org and www.cityscroll.org from Pages project custom domains if attached
Restore Worker custom domains for cityscroll.org and www.cityscroll.org (dashboard first)
Confirm DNS apex/www records are not dangling; do not touch api.* or email MX
Re-run live_url_smoke until green (allow cache lag budget)

visitor_recovery_extra_minutes.note: Redirect/edge cache lag class after DNS or host ownership thrash

rollback_estimate.note: Not a stopwatch trial. After cutover, record an actual timed rollback drill into after_cutover.rollback_wall_clock.

after_cutover.instructions: Fill measured values only after a completed flip + soak. Do not invent improvements.
